name: suggest-engine
description: Editor-agnostic autocomplete suggestion engine with optional user word learning and context ranking.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/index.js --bundle --splitting --format=esm --outdir=dist --entry-names=suggest-engine.esm --chunk-names=chunks/[name]-[hash] && mkdir -p dist/languages && find languages -maxdepth 1 -name '*.ngram.bin' -exec cp {} dist/languages/ \;
